spans.s: 1. औडव mf(ई)n. (fr. उडु), relating to a constellation, Kād.
2. औडव m. (in mus.) a mode which consists of five notes only
pl. N. of a warrior tribe g. दामन्य्-आदि, Pāṇ. v, 3, 116 (not in Kāś.)
a king of the Auḍavis, ib.
a descendant of Uḍa (?) or of Auḍa [T. ?], g. ऐषुकार्य्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 54.
औडायन—भक्त mfn. inhabited by Auḍāyanas (as a country), ib.
